lines.en: Here is here! That is here! Here! Here!
That thing they sell on TV at three in the morning?
Uh, the shampoo isn't just some thing, it's a super rag.
It can absorb 30 times its weight in liquid. What's that?
This'll sop up that juice faster than you could say "sham-pow!"
- I think she meant the gigantic bird. - Oh. This is Marvin. He's an ostrich. I just bought him.
- Your magic meatball told you to? - Yes.
You guys want to know what I'm doing?
I bought one of those screaming Mel dolls, and see?
I made him look like me!
Remember how he used to scream stuff?
Well, I wiped his audio chip.
And I put my voice on it.
So now it says stuff that I often say, like...
Can you make him say, "I've gotta quit playing with dolls and get a job?"
I can't believe you went all the way to Canada.
Uh, it wasn't a total loss.
I bought Canadian bacon while I was there!
He teaches me Japanese phrases, and if I don't say 'em right,
he shocks me with his collar. I hate it!
It's magnetically locked until you get past level one!
The pain is melting my throat!
Oh, she teaches you how to speak Swedish.
I bought her when I bought him.
Hi, did you order some pillows from PillowMyHead.com?
- I did, yes. - Is that here?
I am so psyched to get these.
I read that their pillows really support your head and neck while you sleep.
Wait, I just ordered two pillows.
Yeah, but that was before I--
No, no, no, no, no, no!
You need to take 198 of these pillows, bang!
Um, I asked for an orange.
- You didn't say pork roast? - No.
- What's that for? - Ah, the fire department sent us a letter saying we've reached our maximum number of calls for the year.
And I just fixed the nozzle to make it extra powerful.
Gonna mount it on the wall over there.
- Seems like a good place to mount it. - Thanks.
I need to show you how this works in case there's ever a fire and I'm not home.
See that paper cup right there?
- I see the cup. - Imagine, I'm not home and that cup is on fire.
"Oh, I'm a young girl at home and there's a fire!"
And then you just put the extinguisher back in its wall bracket.
- I got bags! - Oh yeah, you went shopping.
- What'd you get? - Well, let's see.
- I bought a lot of butter. - Clearly.
- Is this all you got? - No!
I also got this thingy that makes the water in your toilet turn blue.
Great. So for dinner, we can have butter and blue toilet water.
Hey, stop by the market on my way home.
And Carly's been hijacked by a psychotic she-duck!
My proton cruiser, I just bought it!
It was actually used in the actual filming of Galaxy Wars.
- In the Battle of Panthatar? - And the rescue of the horclofts from the planet Juveron!
- So you're making her dinner? - Uh-huh.
She wrote in her online profile that she likes sophisticated men who can cook.
So I'm making her dinner, and I bought these.
- Where'd you get those? - You know Sarko's cousin, the optometrist?
